meta.name: product-video-creator
meta.description: 多智能体协同的商品视频创作流水线，支持从商品信息到成视频的全流程创作：文案生成、故事策划、脚本创作、分镜设计、图片生成、字幕创作、音效推荐及视频合成；适用于电商商品宣传、品牌推广、社交媒体营销等场景

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从商品信息自动生成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作电商或品牌宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate promotional videos from product info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create e-commerce or brand promo videos

howto.what: 将商品信息和需求转化为完整的商品宣传视频。由多个智能体协作完成文案生成、故事策划、脚本创作、分镜设计、图片生成、字幕创作、音效推荐及视频合成。
howto.when: 当用户提供商品信息(名称、卖点、图片等)和视频需求(时长、风格、目标受众)时触发。

say.text: 为这款智能手表制作30秒宣传视频,受众是20-35岁白领。
say.note: 触发整套创作流程,产出MP4视频。

say.text: 根据这份商品资料,做一个60秒的护肤品品牌视频,风格温暖优雅。
say.note: 按步骤生成文案、分镜、图片、字幕与合成。

say.text: 给这款零食拍个15秒抖音式短视频,要活泼快节奏。
say.note: 会生成对应风格的分镜和动感音效方案。

howto.what_en: Turns product information and requirements into a complete promotional video. Multiple agents collaborate on copywriting, story planning, scriptwriting, storyboard design, image generation, subtitle creation, sound effect recommendation, and video compositing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides product info (name, features, images, etc.) and video needs (duration, style, target audience).

say_en.text: Make a 30-second promo video for this smartwatch, targeting young professionals aged 20-35.
say_en.note: Starts the full creation pipeline and outputs an MP4.

say_en.text: Create a 60-second brand video for this skincare product, warm and elegant.
say_en.note: Generates storyboard, images, subtitles, and final video.

say_en.text: Produce a 15-second Douyin-style video for this snack, lively and fast-paced.
say_en.note: Creates fast-paced storyboards and dynamic audio suggestions.
